subject: Buying path alignment — roles, must-haves, and procurement blockers
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Helen Cho <hcho@medsys.ai>, Tom Barrett <tbarrett@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-12T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Buying path alignment — roles, must-haves, and procurement blockers

Hi Helen & Tom,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — appreciate the candid feedback. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we all have the same view of the buying path:  

1) Decision roles (as we understand them)
   - Economic buyer: Tom Barrett (VP of Digital Platforms)
   - Security reviewer: Helen Cho (Head of Security)
   - Procurement & Legal: Novum Health Procurement team
   - Operational champion: Dr. Priya Anand (ML Ops lead) — not on the call today

2) Must-haves called out on the demo
   - SOC 2 attestation and data isolation options (VPC/on-prem)
   - Per-route cost visibility and token-level billing for compliance
   - SLA targets for 99.9% uptime + regional hosting in us-east
   - Integration support for SSO (SAML) and KMS key wrap

3) Short-term ask from Novum for procurement to start review
   - We can share a draft Master Agreement and SOC2 summary by EOD tomorrow (attached: redwood-ma-template_v1.pdf, SOC2-summary.xlsx).
   - Please confirm the procurement contact and desired contract cycle time (30/60/90 days).

4) Proposed next steps / owners
   - Aditya: deliver MA draft + SOC2 summary (tomorrow)
   - Helen: share specific security checklist gaps by Jun 17 (if any)
   - Tom / Procurement: indicate target procurement completion date and any PO/insurer requirements

If that aligns, I’ll flag a short 30-min sync next week to walk Legal/Procurement through the MA and highlight the security controls.

Minor ask: is there an internal procurement identifier we should reference on the MA (e.g., PO prefix or contract intake ID)?

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-ma-template_v1.pdf (draft), SOC2-summary.xlsx (summary)
From: Helen Cho <hcho@medsys.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Tom Barrett <tbarrett@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Novum Health Procurement <procurement@novumhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T16:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Buying path alignment — roles, must-haves, and procurement blockers

Aditya — thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from security:  

- SOC 2: we’ll need the full report (or a bridge letter) plus a controls matrix mapping to our internal controls. SOC2-summary.xlsx is a helpful start but we’ll likely ask for the auditor contact.
- Data handling: confirm that customer data can be pinned to our VPC region and that log retention policies are configurable.
- Pen test: does Redwood offer recent pen test reports or Third-Party Risk Assessment (TPRA) docs?

We’ll aim to return a short list of items by Jun 17. On procurement timing: we typically do a 60-day review for new vendors of this class, but if Legal sees standard terms we can compress to 30. I’ll loop in Legal if we need redlines.

Also copying procurement so they can confirm the PO process.

On the sync: a 30-min walk-through with Legal/Procurement would be useful — suggest Wed 2027-06-16 at 10:00am ET if that works for your team.

Thanks,
Helen Cho
Head of Security 
Novum Health

--

Date: 2027-06-12T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Buying path alignment — roles, must-haves, and procurement blockers

Thanks Helen — that timeline works. Quick answers inline and next steps:  

- SOC 2: full report is available under NDA; I’ve attached a one-page controls mapping (SOC2-summary.xlsx) and will provide auditor contact when you’re ready for the NDA.
- VPC / data locality: we support VPC peering and region pinning for hosted customers; I’ll include a tech note in the packet.
- Pen test/TPRA: recent pen test summary is available — will add to the packet (we can share the full report on an NDA).

Proposed plan:
  1) I’ll post the MA draft + expanded attachments to the shared Drive tonight (pricing-scenarios-3q.csv included).
  2) Let’s do the 30-min legal/procure walkthrough on Wed 2027-06-16 at 10:00am ET — I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.
  3) Vivek (cc’d) will own commercial/discount questions and finalize the initial pricing scenarios for your review.

Question for Procurement: do you require a specific contract clause for incident response timelines or breach notification windows? If so, flag it now and we’ll bake it into the MA.

Aditya Rao
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Attachments posted to Drive: redwood-ma-template_v1.pdf, SOC2-summary.xlsx, pricing-scenarios-3q.csv
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Helen Cho <hcho@medsys.ai>, Tom Barrett <tbarrett@novumhealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Novum Health Procurement <procurement@novumhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-13T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Buying path alignment — roles, must-haves, and procurement blockers

Hey team — looping in on the commercial side. Thanks for the detail, Helen. A few commercial clarifications to speed procurement:  

- Payment terms: standard Redwood is Net30, but we can accommodate Net45 for enterprise agreements.
- Term & renewal: propose 12-month initial term with an optional auto-renew unless either party gives notice.
- Pricing flexibility: Aditya shared three scenarios; my recommendation is Scenario B (moderate commit + burst). I’ll include a redline-ready MA that highlights any non-standard clauses for Legal to review.

Aditya — I’ll draft the MA redline tonight and flag the following optional concessions we can fast-track if the customer signs within 30 days:
  1) One quarter of free Reserved capacity credits (applied against the first invoice)
  2) Dedicated onboarding support (3 days)

Helen / Tom — please advise if those concessions are acceptable to your stakeholders; if Procurement needs PO references or internal intake IDs, forward and we’ll append to the MA.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Commercial 
Redwood Inference
